question: Can a governed wrap or R5 lever make the inherited lift≥1.30 bar reachable, so reachable-bars and typed-path should wait on one graph change?
verdict: NO — do not open a wrap/R5 rebuild card to unlock the old bar. Split stands: A-reachable is a metric/target redesign; A-typed-path stays its own diagnostic.

wrap.code: set_dehydron_wrap_max refuses any value other than DEHYDRON_WRAP_MAX (addendum §2.7)
wrap.what_it_changes: R1 vs R2 among existing H-bonds only. It does not add or remove R5 edges.
wrap.read: Even illegal wrap extremes do not make bar 1.30 satisfiable.

r5.cutoff: CB neighborhood 8.0 Å (_detect_r5_pairs); residual after R1–R4 exclusivity
r5.strongest_counterfactual: drop all R5 edges from cached graphs and recompute sdrp_heuristic_from_edges (not a rebuild, not a train)
r5.read: Omitting R5 replaces one majority (neighborhood) with another (core from R0+R1 argmax). The 1.30 bar stays structurally unreachable. Argmax-over-counts, not R5 volume alone, is why classes 2/3 stay empty.

implication_for_agenda.A-r5-graph-lever-joint-check: DONE — lever does not unlock the inherited bar
implication_for_agenda.A-reachable-bars-or-less-skewed-target: OPEN — next is a reachable metric or a non-argmax target, not a wrap/R5 graph card
implication_for_agenda.A-typed-path-utilization: OPEN — unchanged; prior probe already showed uniform edge_type does not restore rel_bias, and this check does not merge the two

not_claims: not permission to retune wrap off 1
not a proposal to delete R5 from the model graph
not evidence the architecture cannot fit a reachable target
method: Cached wrap=1 graphs for the 12 LOSO structures; sdrp_heuristic_from_edges under edge drops/remaps. No training. No loader edit.
